newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: - Feeder steers and heifers were steady, with those under 500 lbs steady to firm, compared to last week, USDA said. Feeder steers and heifers over 500 lbs were mostly steady.
Trade was active and demand good. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 500-800 lb feeder steers and heifers.

Supply included around 9 percent slaughter cows and bulls, 70 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs. Cattle and Calves - 1,166 Last Week - 2,198 Last Year- 480
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 79.00- 82.75; pkg 805 lbs 76.25; pkg 875 lbs 71.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 74.50-78.50; 700-800 lbs 73.00- 75.00; pkg 800 lbs 69.50.
